pamphlet_excerpts: Health Care Professions Sub-Req 1a: Briefly describe to your counselor the roles these professionals play in the delivery of health care.
Health Care Professions Sub-Req 1b: Describe to your counselor the educational and licensing requirements for the professionals you selected.

Core Standard 1 (Req 1): Select three of the professions from Group 1 listed below which interest you, then complete the following: Group 1: (1) Allopathic physician (MD), all specialties (2) Osteopathic physician (DO), all specialties (3) Podiatrist (DPM) (4) Chiropractor (DC) (5) Nurse Practitioner (NP) (6) Psychologist (PhD or PsyD) (7) Optometrist (OD) (8) Audiologist (AudD) (a) Briefly describe to your counselor the roles these professionals play in the delivery of health care.
Core Standard 2 (Req 1): (b) Describe to your counselor the educational and licensing requirements for the professionals you selected.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 1): Review the official Health Care Professions requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Health Care Professions Careers, Training & Hobby Pathways.
Execute & Document: Perform the select task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Health Care Professions Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 8): Identify a medical advancement or discovery that has been in the news recently.
Core Standard 2 (Req 8): Discuss with your counselor how this can affect patient care.
Safety & Policy Alignment: Follow the BSA Guide to Safe Scouting, Two-Deep Leadership, and the Buddy System during all Health Care Professions Req 8 activities.
Counselor Conference Readiness: Record concrete observations, examples, and sketches in your Health Care Professions Workbook before requesting Requirement 8 sign-off.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 8): Review the official Health Care Professions requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Identify a medical advancement or discovery that has.
Execute & Document: Perform the identify task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Health Care Professions Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
